# TechAccountingPro

> Technical accounting firm for crypto, Web3 and digital asset companies. Big 4 (KPMG) trained, led by founder Andrei Belonogov (PhD, CPA, FCCA). US GAAP reporting, technical accounting memos, audit readiness and token accounting, delivered on a subscription basis. Founded March 2022, headquartered in Louisville, KY, serving clients worldwide.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://techaccountingpro.com/#services): financial reporting, technical accounting (ASC 606, going concern), transaction support (business combinations, SAFEs, consolidation), technical crypto accounting (token grants, SAFTs, token compensation, staking, DAO/foundation consolidation), change management (IFRS to US GAAP, ERP conversion), process and governance.
- [Subscription plans](https://techaccountingpro.com/#pricing)
